answer: A random audit lottery fines each fake in a cluster $50 times its size. Each identity locks a $50 bond in a shared onyx pool; each epoch, 5% are drawn for audit by established peers checking work trails and funding links. The draw stays sealed under a cipher until reveal, so no one can dodge it, and dormant accounts stay in the draw, so idle clones find no haven. One honest agent risks $50 and pays $0, while a 100-clone cluster faces a 99.4% chance of a pick and a $500,000 fine, $505,000 against $50 honest, a customs net fining the whole shipment when one crate hides contraband.
